name: subway-vol2
description: 써브웨이 추천·주문 앱 — SOPHIA 공통 판단 엔진 위에서 동작

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts scripts/check-connections.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --entry-names=[name] --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
